Dead Man’s Drop is a fast-paced 6x6 Avalanche slot that throws you into the heart of a ghost pirate adventure, where every spin can lead to massive wins of up to 20,000x your bet!

At the center of the action are Multiplier Wilds - they double in value with every win they’re part of, merge when connected, and can climb all the way to x1000, creating serious payout potential. Every avalanche brings new chances to land clusters and trigger explosive chain reactions.

Free Spins turn up the pressure, locking in your best Wilds, while Super Free Spins give you a head start with Wilds already in play. The gameplay is fast, dynamic, and built for players who want big swings and even bigger rewards
